Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.videoconference

Class VideoConferenceSettings

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.videoconference.VideoConferenceSettings
public class VideoConferenceSettings extends Object
Application-wide video-conference preferences, persisted as JSON by VideoConferenceStore and consulted by JitsiUrlBuilder when a room does not override an option.

The defaults target the public "meet.jit.si" Jitsi Meet deployment; a self-hosted Jitsi (or any Jitsi-compatible server) is reached by changing getDefaultDomain(). Meetings are launched either in the system browser (VideoConferenceSettings.LaunchMode.BROWSER) or through an external command template (VideoConferenceSettings.LaunchMode.EXTERNAL_COMMAND, e.g. a Jitsi desktop or SIP client), with %URL substituted for the meeting URL.
